meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会主持一个只读站会：每个工作区、分支或 PR 作为一位「代理」，在同一会议文件里轮流发言、对比改动并解决冲突，最后给出一份整合计划（合并目标、顺序、需要你决定的事项）。不会直接合并代码。
howto.when: 当你要求对多个工作区、分支或 PR 做一次只读 standup、比较分散的改动，或把它们汇总成一份合并计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我把最近 24 小时内有改动的工作区开一次 standup，给一份合并计划。
say.note: 先列出候选并请你确认，再开始讨论。

say.text: 把这个分支和这几个 PR 的改动放在一起对比，给一份整合方案。
say.note: 会让你点选要参与的分支/PR，然后安排它们发言。

say.text: 看看这些工作区里谁有真代码、谁只是文档，给一个合并顺序。
say.note: 会区分各分支内容并给出顺序，再把要你拍板的问题问出来。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a read-only standup: each worktree/branch/PR is an agent in a shared file, exchanging intros and resolving conflicts, then writes one consolidation plan (target, order, decisions). No merging happens inside the room.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a read-only standup across worktrees, branches, or PRs, to compare their changes, or to fold them into one consolidation plan.

say_en.text: Run a standup for worktrees changed in the last 24h and give me a merge plan.
say_en.note: Lists candidates and asks you to confirm before starting.

say_en.text: Compare this branch with these PRs and consolidate them into one plan.
say_en.note: Asks which branches/PRs to include, then agents discuss.

say_en.text: Which worktrees have real code and which are docs only? Give a merge order.
say_en.note: Briefs each branch, gives target and open decisions.
